_note: Manual keys read from neurometabench merged annotation note keys (data/nimads/emotion_regulation_2022/merged/nimads_annotation.json; 88 studies, 161 notes). The auto side is an identity mapping and is LIVE: v2-annotation-only.yaml defines annotations named exactly decrease/increase/maintain/reappraisal. Those criteria were written from the source paper's full text and its supplementary Table S1, and were reviewed and approved by the project author on 2026-08-27. They get ported into v2-allstudies.yaml once trialled -- v2, not v3, because v3-allstudies regressed (full-text TP 42 -> 19). NOTE two gold-file defects recorded in v2-annotation-only.yaml's header: Decrease.txt holds the reappraisal union (152 vs an expected 130) and Maintain.txt is missing ~97 of 104 Look experiments, so the decrease and maintain columns are not interpretable until the gold is rebuilt. This _note key is ignored by scripts/nmb_mapping.py, which reads only annotation_mappings when present.
